title: 10. Exercises: Topic 3: Encapsulation - Exercises
summary: Create a Student class with encapsulated attributes for name, student_id, and grades.
objectives: Solve the Topic 3: Encapsulation - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Student Grade Management System
sections.body:
Create a `Student` class with encapsulated attributes for name, student_id, and grades. Implement:
- Private attributes for grades
- Property decorators for name and student_id with validation
- Methods to add grades, calculate average, and get grade report
- Validation: name must be 2+ characters, student_id must be 6 digits, grades must be 0-100

sections.title: Exercise 2: Bank Account with Enhanced Security
sections.body:
Create a `SecureBankAccount` class with:
- Private password and balance
- Protected transaction history
- Public account number
- Methods for deposit, withdraw, and transfer with password verification
- Property for balance with read-only access
- Transaction limits and fraud detection

sections.title: Exercise 3: Product Inventory System
sections.body:
Create a `Product` class with:
- Private attributes for cost, profit_margin, and supplier_info
- Protected stock_level and reorder_point
- Public name and description
- Properties for price (calculated from cost + margin) and profit
- Methods to update stock, calculate profit, and check reorder status
- Validation for all numeric values

sections.title: Exercise 4: Temperature Sensor Class
sections.body:
Create a `TemperatureSensor` class with:
- Private calibration_offset and last_reading
- Protected sensor_id and location
- Properties for current_temperature with validation
- Methods to calibrate sensor, take reading, and get sensor status
- Temperature range validation (-50°C to 150°C)
- Automatic calibration tracking

sections.title: Exercise 5: User Authentication System
sections.body:
Create a `User` class with:
- Private password_hash and login_attempts
- Protected email and last_login
- Public username
- Properties for email with validation
- Methods for password change, login verification, and account lockout
- Password strength validation and hash storage

sections.title: Exercise 6: Shopping Cart with Discount Rules
sections.body:
Create a `ShoppingCart` class with:
- Private discount_rules and applied_coupons
- Protected items and subtotal
- Properties for total, tax, and final_total
- Methods to add/remove items, apply coupons, and calculate totals
- Complex discount logic (percentage, fixed amount, buy-one-get-one)
- Inventory validation

sections.title: Exercise 7: Library Book with Advanced Features
sections.body:
Create a `LibraryBook` class with:
- Private reservation_queue and damage_reports
- Protected current_borrower and due_date
- Public title, author, and isbn
- Properties for availability_status and overdue_fines
- Methods for borrowing, returning, reserving, and reporting damage
- ISBN validation and fine calculation

sections.title: Exercise 8: Employee Payroll System
sections.body:
Create an `Employee` class with:
- Private tax_info and performance_ratings
- Protected salary and benefits
- Public employee_id and name
- Properties for net_salary and tax_bracket
- Methods for salary adjustment, bonus calculation, and tax computation
- Complex tax calculation with multiple brackets

sections.title: Exercise 9: Vehicle Rental System
sections.body:
Create a `RentalVehicle` class with:
- Private maintenance_history and insurance_details
- Protected current_renter and rental_rate
- Public vehicle_id and model
- Properties for availability and daily_rate
- Methods for renting, returning, maintenance scheduling, and rate adjustment
- Rental period validation and maintenance tracking

sections.title: Exercise 10: Restaurant Order Management
sections.body:
Create a `RestaurantOrder` class with:
- Private kitchen_notes and payment_details
- Protected order_items and preparation_time
- Public order_id and customer_name
- Properties for total_amount and estimated_completion
- Methods for adding items, updating status, and calculating totals
- Menu validation and preparation time estimation

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Advanced Data Validation
Implement custom validators for:
- Email format validation
- Phone number format validation
- Credit card number validation (Luhn algorithm)
- Date range validation
- Currency format validation

### Challenge 2: Immutable Objects
Create immutable classes using:
- `@property` decorators without setters
- `__slots__` for memory optimization
- Custom `__setattr__` method to prevent modification
- Factory methods for object creation

### Challenge 3: Observer Pattern with Encapsulation
Implement an observer pattern where:
- Subject class has private observers list
- Observer interface with protected update method
- Event-driven updates with encapsulated data
- Automatic observer management

### Challenge 4: Database Integration
Create classes that integrate with a simple file-based database:
- Private database connection details
- Protected query methods
- Public CRUD operations
- Data validation before storage
- Transaction management

### Challenge 5: Configuration Management
Build a configuration system with:
- Private configuration file path
- Protected default values
- Public configuration access
- Validation of configuration values
- Automatic configuration persistence
